sections.markdown:
## F — Structured research index and consolidated VERIFY list: rules of the road
Knowledge facts: part C holds 39 fact blocks (sec04-F01 onward) from physical pages 24 to 29; part C2 holds 19 confusable and continuation blocks (sec04-R01 onward).
Exam authority: part A states the issuer, the Revised August 2026 guide, the 25-question written test and the passing standard of 20 correct answers (80 percent) from physical pages 1, 3, 4 and 20; the time limit is unknown.
VERIFY list:
- MO-ROAD-A-TIME — written-test time limit not printed in the guide (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- MO-ROAD-D-HANDSIGNALS — hand-signal arm positions shown only as images (owner EvidenceLibrarian).
- MO-ROAD-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- MO-ROAD-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: the work zone fine minimums (sec04-F03) are statutory and can change, and local ordinances (sec04-R19) vary by city and county and must be checked locally.

corpus_stability.reason: The Missouri Driver Guide prints a single edition line on its front cover (Revised August 2026); its table-of-contents note says law and policy changes may make parts out of date and points to the website for the current version, with no sign in the selected pages of more than one rewrite per year.
